category_title: Students with persistent challenging behavior referred for individualized support
scenario_title: Large group reading instruction evoking attention-maintained behavior
minimal_context: The student is participating in a large group reading instruction activity where the class is asked to read from their textbooks.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Everyone, please open your reading books to page 12 so we can read the next chapter together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts head down on desk and starts making inappropriate vocalizations while the rest of the group opens their books.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit up and open your book to page 12.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leaves seat without permission, walks over to the student at the next desk, and starts touching their reading materials.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go back to your seat and leave their things alone.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shouts above the current conversational level) I'm not going back! (Takes the peer's reading materials without permission and drops them on the floor.)
